import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
data = pd.read_csv('validation_scores.csv')
thresholds = pd.read_csv('thresholds.csv')
contract = pd.read_csv('acceptance_contract.csv')
p = contract.iloc[0]
y = data['actual_label'].to_numpy()
scores = data['score'].to_numpy()
assert scores.shape == y.shape
positive = y == 1
negative = y == 0
# Supplied threshold protocol preserves probability representation and declared order.
predictions = [scores >= threshold for threshold in thresholds['threshold']]
tp_masks = [(y == 1) & pred for pred in predictions]
fp_masks = [(y == 0) & pred for pred in predictions]
fn_masks = [(y == 1) & ~pred for pred in predictions]
tn_masks = [(y == 0) & ~pred for pred in predictions]
count_masks = tp_masks + fp_masks + fn_masks + tn_masks
count_matrix = np.asarray(count_masks).T
# Axis handling is supplied; write the taught count operation below.
count_by_mask = lambda operation: operation(count_matrix, axis=0)
tp0 = tp_masks[0]
tp1 = tp_masks[1]
fp0 = fp_masks[0]
fp1 = fp_masks[1]
fn0 = fn_masks[0]
fn1 = fn_masks[1]
tn0 = tn_masks[0]
tn1 = tn_masks[1]
# Complete the following learner analysis lines; retain all scaffold statements.
tp0_count = None
tp1_count = None
fp0_count = None
fp1_count = None
fn0_count = None
fn1_count = None
tn0_count = None
tn1_count = None
counts = [tp0_count,tp1_count,fp0_count,fp1_count,fn0_count,fn1_count,tn0_count,tn1_count] if tp0_count is not None else None
records = []
if counts is not None:
    size = len(thresholds)
    for i,row in thresholds.iterrows():
        tp,fp,fn,tn = [int(counts[i+j*size]) for j in range(4)]
        neg,pos = fp+tn,fn+tp
        fpr,fnr = (fp/neg if neg else None),(fn/pos if pos else None)
        cost = p.deployment_negative_probability*fpr*p.cost_FP+p.deployment_positive_probability*fnr*p.cost_FN if fpr is not None and fnr is not None else None
        eligible = cost is not None and cost <= p.expected_cost_bound
        records.append({'threshold':row.threshold,'score_representation':row.score_representation,'TP':tp,'FP':fp,'FN':fn,'TN':tn,'FPR':fpr,'FNR':fnr,'expected_error_cost':cost,'eligible':eligible})
eligible_records = [r for r in records if r['eligible']]
selected = min(eligible_records,key=lambda r:r['expected_error_cost']) if eligible_records else None
result = {'records':records,'selected':selected,'retention':'Retain the selected threshold, probability representation and validation record unchanged; no protected-test access.'}

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
data = pd.read_csv('validation_scores.csv')
thresholds = pd.read_csv('thresholds.csv')
contract = pd.read_csv('acceptance_contract.csv')
p = contract.iloc[0]
y = data['actual_label'].to_numpy()
scores = data['score'].to_numpy()
assert scores.shape == y.shape
positive = y == 1
negative = y == 0
# Supplied threshold protocol preserves probability representation and declared order.
predictions = [scores >= threshold for threshold in thresholds['threshold']]
tp_masks = [(y == 1) & pred for pred in predictions]
fp_masks = [(y == 0) & pred for pred in predictions]
fn_masks = [(y == 1) & ~pred for pred in predictions]
tn_masks = [(y == 0) & ~pred for pred in predictions]
count_masks = tp_masks + fp_masks + fn_masks + tn_masks
count_matrix = np.asarray(count_masks).T
# Axis handling is supplied; write the taught count operation below.
count_by_mask = lambda operation: operation(count_matrix, axis=0)
tp0 = tp_masks[0]
tp1 = tp_masks[1]
fp0 = fp_masks[0]
fp1 = fp_masks[1]
fn0 = fn_masks[0]
fn1 = fn_masks[1]
tn0 = tn_masks[0]
tn1 = tn_masks[1]
tp0_count = np.count_nonzero(tp0)
tp1_count = np.count_nonzero(tp1)
fp0_count = np.count_nonzero(fp0)
fp1_count = np.count_nonzero(fp1)
fn0_count = np.count_nonzero(fn0)
fn1_count = np.count_nonzero(fn1)
tn0_count = np.count_nonzero(tn0)
tn1_count = np.count_nonzero(tn1)
counts = [tp0_count,tp1_count,fp0_count,fp1_count,fn0_count,fn1_count,tn0_count,tn1_count] if tp0_count is not None else None
records = []

        eligible = cost is not None and cost <= p.expected_cost_bound
        records.append({'threshold':row.threshold,'score_representation':row.score_representation,'TP':tp,'FP':fp,'FN':fn,'TN':tn,'FPR':fpr,'FNR':fnr,'expected_error_cost':cost,'eligible':eligible})
eligible_records = [r for r in records if r['eligible']]
selected = min(eligible_records,key=lambda r:r['expected_error_cost']) if eligible_records else None
result = {'records':records,'selected':selected,'retention':'Retain the selected threshold, probability representation and validation record unchanged; no protected-test access.'}

blocks.text: Eligibility comes before ranking.
Compare candidates and baseline on the same evaluation dataset and predeclared requirements, not incomparable cohorts.
Use the same supplied deployment probabilities and error costs for every record. Exclude fixed-limit failures, then rank eligible records by the declared cost rule.
FPR = FP/(FP+TN) uses actual negatives; FNR = FN/(FN+TP) uses actual positives. Empty groups do not define rates.
With zero correct-prediction cost, expected cost = P(Y=0) × FPR × cost_FP + P(Y=1) × FNR × cost_FN, using supplied deployment probabilities.
Protected-test observations stay outside preprocessing fit, model choice and tuning, which would leak information into the chosen system.

result_of.sql:
WITH checked AS (
 SELECT r.*, r.rowid AS declared_order, k.deployment_negative_probability, k.deployment_positive_probability,
 k.cost_FP, k.cost_FN, k.expected_cost_bound,
 CASE WHEN actual_positive_count = 0 OR actual_negative_count = 0 THEN 'undefined required rate'
 WHEN cohort_id != (SELECT cohort_id FROM records LIMIT 1) THEN 'different cohort'
 WHEN expected_error_cost > k.expected_cost_bound THEN 'quality limit'
 WHEN NOT (r.latency_requirement_met = 1 AND r.scale_requirement_met = 1 AND r.training_cost_requirement_met = 1 AND r.serving_cost_requirement_met = 1 AND r.maintenance_requirement_met = 1 AND r.deployment_compatibility_met = 1) THEN 'operating limit' ELSE 'eligible' END AS eligibility
 FROM records r CROSS JOIN contract k),
 ranked AS (SELECT candidate_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY expected_error_cost, declared_order) AS eligible_rank
 FROM checked WHERE eligibility = 'eligible')
 SELECT checked.*, ranked.eligible_rank,
 CASE WHEN ranked.eligible_rank = 1 THEN 'retain selection' ELSE '' END AS selection
 FROM checked LEFT JOIN ranked USING (candidate_id)

Apply fixed quality and operating limits before ranking. Keep confusion counts, actual-class denominators, deployment probabilities and error costs beside the chosen identity. Operating failures are exclusions, not informal score penalties. Freeze the validation selection without using protected-test observations for fitting or tuning.
The smallest cost is not necessarily the eligible winner; matched evidence and fixed limits matter.
